Santa strides over, gets in Rudolph's face, and orders him to step forward. Tiny Tim points out the harness prevents movement. Rudolph flinches and looks away. Santa holsters his weapon, straightens his coat and hat, then throws a fake punch that makes Rudolph jerk back in fear.
